title: Excalibur Annual #1 Marvel 1993 1st Appearance Khaos 64 Page Total Khaos
condition_description: Light edge and corner wear, small wear spot at the lower-right back corner. Out of the original polybag. See photos.
description:
Excalibur Annual #1 (Marvel, 1993), 64-page annual: "Total Khaos!" First appearance of Khaos. Cover by Mike Marrinan and Mark McKenna, featuring Captain Britain, Nightcrawler, Phoenix (Rachel Summers), Kitty Pryde and Meggan. Direct Edition, $2.95 cover price. Comic only: out of the original polybag, no trading card.

Back cover: Mortal Kombat video game ad.

Condition: light edge and corner wear with a small wear spot at the lower-right back corner (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
